# 00000004379

**KK2-19 ★** — source: 131_代数K理论II_迹方法.md

**English.** Definition: A localization invariant is a homology theory invariant under localization sequences. Conjecture: The spectrum of such invariants is countably generated by the two families K-theory and THH, and the generating family is minimal and irredundant. (minimal K-THH generation of localization invariants)

**中文。** 定义：局部化不变量指对局部化序列不变的同调论。猜想：该不变量谱由 K 理论与 THH 两族可数生成,且生成族最小不可削减。（局部化不变量 K-THH 最小生成）
